answer_text: The KB’s Advanced BGP Settings examples show a common default pair of Hold Time 120 seconds and keep-alive interval 40 seconds. If two BGP neighbors have different Hold Times, the session uses the lower Hold Time (e.g., 30) for both sides, and the keep-alive interval is adjusted accordingly (in the example, a 30-second Hold Time leads to a 10-second keep-alive). In short: default values shown are 120/40, and a lower Hold Time wins with a correlating adjustment to the keep-alive.
